How scoring works: each area (but Attendance) earns +1 for a perfect day (no miss in it) and +2 for every 5 perfect days in a row, and loses the Settings points for each miss; its grade goes by points per day worked (perfect every day = 100; A 93+, B 85+, C 75+). Cases go by the day: every full 54 cases short costs 1 point and every full 54 over earns 1. Attendance earns nothing: the first 4 call-off days in the calendar year are free and each day after costs 3 (a day a manager excuses does not count). Accidents (12 months), PDAs (9 months) and complaints (6 months) count past the period shown, fading as they age; accidents and complaints count once a manager reviews them. Overall is the average of the area grades.

Side: Distribution shifts are the loading shifts; Plant Reports, Shift Notes and Shift Reports go by them. Plant Production shifts are kept for the plant production side. How Plant Reports use the shifts: a load counts for the shift it started loading in. Where two shifts overlap (2:00 to 2:30 PM, 10:00 to 10:30 PM) it stays with the earlier shift. A load with no Start time counts by its End time, and a load never loaded counts for the shift on duty at its depart time. Breakdowns, temperatures and pickups go by when they were logged or by their load. A time between shifts (5:30 to 6:00 AM) belongs to the shift that just ended.

How scoring works: each area (but Attendance) earns +1 for a perfect day (no miss in it) and +2 for every 5 perfect days in a row, and loses the Settings points for each miss; its grade goes by points per day worked (perfect every day = 100; A 93+, B 85+, C 75+). Cases go by the day: every full 54 cases short costs 1 point and every full 54 over earns 1. Attendance earns nothing: the first 4 call-off days in the calendar year are free and each day after costs 3 (a day a manager excuses does not count). Accidents (12 months), PDAs (9 months) and complaints (6 months) count past the period shown, fading as they age; accidents and complaints count once a manager reviews them. Overall is the average of the area grades.
